Set up two-factor authentication

Two-factor authentication is required for this dashboard. You'll only need to do this once.

Can't scan? Enter this key in your app:
  1. Open an authenticator appGoogle Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password all work.
  2. Scan the QR codeOr add an account manually using the key below the code.
  3. Enter the 6-digit code your app shows
